content.short: ease is a DeFi coverage aggregator that lets users secure assets against hacks.
content.description: ease is a peer-to-peer insurance protocol that distributes losses from hacks across the entire ecosystem, delivering true risk-sharing without premiums, leverage, or ongoing maintenance. It provides full-stack coverage at a cost cheaper than the standard premiums charged by other insurance protocols. Protection extends to a range of popular DeFi projects, including Sushiswap, AAVE, Compound, Convex, Curve, Yearn, and more, creating a scalable safety net for the broader ecosystem. This approach promotes broad participation and resilience as the DeFi landscape evolves.
